title: Arizer Extreme Q Vaporizer with LOTS OF EXTRAS (taxes extra)
description:
The LOTS OF EXTRAS package.

Every feature you want, every extra you want

The Extreme Q Vaporizer by Arizer is a great herbal desktop vaporizer that is easy to use, very efficient and creates great tasting vapor

The Extreme Q has passed the test of time, one of the first direct flow and bag vaporizers to hit the market, it became the new standard in multi-use desktop vaporizers. Ultra reliable, solid warranty, readily available parts, the Extreme Q is a great choice for anyone looking for a desktop vaporizer. Every feature you could want like digital controls, fan speed adjuster and a remote plus more, the Extreme Q does it all.

We highly recommend the Extreme Q.

Features
Midnight Chrome Finish
Low noise fan (Q stands for Quiet)
Compact Design for a desktop
Clear View LCD
Fast heating ceramic heater
Precise Temperature Control with triple heat sensors
Energy efficient
Designed with Solid State Circuitry

Included in the kit:
– 1 Remote Control
– 1 Mini Whip for Balloons
– 1 Three Foot Whip with MP
– Balloon with Mouthpiece
– Potpourri Dish
– 1 Cyclone Bowls
– 1 Glass Stirring Tool
– Extra Screens
– AC Adapter
– Instructions

LOTS OF EXTRA KIT INCLUDES:
2 Dome Screens
3 Feet of Tubing
Extra Elbow with Screen for whip
Extra All Glass Mini Whip for balloons
2 Balloons
1 Cyclone Bowl
4 Piece Premium Grinder
Cleaning Brush

CLICK HERE FOR OUR REVIEW

ARIZER XQ2 DESKTOP ALSO NOW AVAILABLE
The Sequel to the Extreme Q is finally here

3 year warranty on the unit and 1 year warranty on the AC adapter

Warranty Information
